meta.name: financial-modeling
meta.description: Builds and stress-tests financial models for forecasting, scenario planning, and decision support — revenue build, cost structure, driver logic, and the sensitivities that show where a plan breaks. Use this to model a decision's financial consequence, build a forecast or long-range plan, evaluate an investment or hire, or pressure-test someone else's model before relying on it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立并压力测试财务模型，预测经营结果并找出计划脆弱点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做决策前需要先算清财务后果。
copy.tagline_en: Build and stress-test financial models to see where your plan breaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to weigh the financial consequences of a decision before committing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按“输入—计算—输出”三层搭建财务模型：假设集中、公式无硬编码数字，用销量×价格等驱动构建收入与成本；还会做敏感性、盈亏平衡、下行情形测试，并在审查模型时核查硬编码数字、行一致性和极端值。
howto.when: 当你提出与财务建模相关的请求时触发，例如评估决策后果、构建预测或长期计划、压力测试他人模型等。

say.text: 帮我建一个未来三年收入预测模型，用销量×价格驱动。
say.note: 会得到带输入假设区的驱动式模型。

say.text: 我这份假设表里哪些数字对结果影响最大？做敏感性分析。
say.note: 带你找关键变量并计算盈亏平衡。

say.text: 检查一下这个Excel模型，找硬编码数字和行不一致。

howto.what_en: Claude structures models into Inputs/Calculations/Outputs, sources assumptions, bans hard-coded numbers, builds revenue via drivers like volume × price, stress-tests via sensitivities, breakevens, and downside cases, and audits models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request financial modeling, e.g., to assess a decision's consequence, build a forecast or long-range plan, or stress-test someone else's model.

say_en.text: Build me a 3-year revenue forecast model driven by volume × price.
say_en.note: You'll get a driver-based model with an assumptions sheet.

say_en.text: Which assumptions move my result most? Run sensitivities.
Audit this Excel model for hard-coded constants and row inconsistencies.
